// Package badpkg is a synthetic KNOWN-BAD fixture for
// schemaversion_stamp_gate_test.go's TestEveryPointWriteRoutesThroughPayload.
// Both functions transmit a REAL request via a REAL `Upsert` call, and both
// bypass the payload() codec — the two bypass shapes the write-boundary gate
// exists to catch:
//
//	(a) handBuiltPayload — a hand-built payload map is constructed INLINE
//	    into the point and transmitted via client.Upsert. A shape that
//	    could carry a schema_version key by hand and still never call
//	    payload().
//	(b) helperBuiltWrite — the request is assembled by a SEPARATE HELPER
//	    FUNCTION (buildRequest) and transmitted through a local variable,
//	    so the enclosing function that actually calls Upsert contains NO
//	    qdrant.PointStruct literal of its own whatsoever. This is the H1
//	    bypass a construction-anchored scanner cannot see at all: the
//	    write happens in a function with no composite literal to scan.
//
// This file carries a .go.txt extension deliberately: it is parsed from
// source bytes by go/parser, never built by `go build`/gofmt/go vet/the
// linter, so it is not swept by any of them.
package badpkg

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/qdrant/go-client/qdrant"
)

type writer struct {
	client *qdrant.Client
}

// handBuiltPayload transmits a request whose Payload is a hand-built map
// literal, never routed through payload(). Non-conforming.
func (w *writer) handBuiltPayload(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	_, err := w.client.Upsert(ctx, &qdrant.UpsertPoints{
		CollectionName: "badpkg",
		Points: []*qdrant.PointStruct{{
			Id:      qdrant.NewID(id),
			Payload: qdrant.NewValueMap(map[string]any{"content": "hand-built, never through payload()"}),
		}},
	})
	return err
}

// buildRequest assembles a request in a SEPARATE HELPER FUNCTION from the
// one that transmits it (helperBuiltWrite, below) — the H1 bypass shape.
func buildRequest(id string) *qdrant.UpsertPoints {
	return &qdrant.UpsertPoints{
		CollectionName: "badpkg",
		Points: []*qdrant.PointStruct{{
			Id:      qdrant.NewID(id),
			Payload: qdrant.NewValueMap(map[string]any{"content": "built elsewhere, never through payload()"}),
		}},
	}
}

// helperBuiltWrite transmits a request built by buildRequest through a
// local variable. This function's own body contains NO PointStruct literal
// — a scanner anchored on qdrant.PointStruct construction rather than the
// transmitted Upsert call would never see this write at all.
func (w *writer) helperBuiltWrite(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	req := buildRequest(id)
	_, err := w.client.Upsert(ctx, req)
	return err
}
